name: 谢雨卿
chinese_bio: 谢雨卿（2000年10月——2120年10月？），男，汉族，四川绵阳人，伟大的马克思主义美食家、旅行家和思想家，酒精考验的无产阶级战士。2025年6月毕业于中国社会科学院大学，2027年4月毕业于马来西亚城市大学，此后浪迹天涯，不知所终，据说活到了120岁。晚年好为人师，年纪也大了，人们或者出于礼貌，或者出于讽刺，都叫他“谢哥”。
谢哥生前喜欢读书、写作，也颇有一些作品，部分发到了公众号“谢雨聊”上。喜欢科学技术，尤其喜欢数学，但是谢哥爱数学就像叶公好龙，真让他学他又搞不懂。好在赶上AI发展，他便开始用AI做一些小应用——这个网站便是他用AI做的。
网站收录了谢哥的文章、AI应用、摄影作品、小游戏等，部分地反映了谢哥这个人的精神世界。很多人通过这个网站了解谢哥，也有很多人来这里只是为了玩游戏。这个网站在2120年以前都由谢哥本人运营，不断更新；2120年以后遵其遗嘱，由他的AI机器人继续维护。
谢哥的作品涵盖了历史、地理、社会、科技、个人感悟等多个主题，忠实记录了他的所见所闻所思所想，以及各国的风土人情，我们能从他的文章管中窥豹，了解21世纪人类社会的生产方式，以及当时人类的生活方式和思维方式。他的文章即使没有科学的意义，也具有文学的意义；即使没有文学的意义，也毕竟具有历史的意义。还是值得一读的。
21世纪仍然是资本主义的世纪，当时的人类具有很大的时代局限性和阶级局限性，这是不可避免的，谢哥也不例外。希望读者在审视谢哥及其作品的时候，不要用今天的道德水平和精神境界去苛求一个21世纪的古人——在他们那个时代，谢哥还是比较进步的。至少不反动。
谢哥生前喜欢曹丕在《典论·论文》里的一句话：“盖文章，经国之大业，不朽之盛事。年寿有时而尽，荣乐止乎其身，二者必至之常期，未若文章之无穷。”现在谢哥将自己的文章留在了这个网站，按照他的标准，他已经不朽了。
english_bio: Xie Yuqing (October 2000 – October 2120?), male, Han Chinese, from Mianyang, Sichuan. A great Marxist gourmet, traveller and thinker, and a proletarian fighter tested by alcohol. He graduated from the University of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences in June 2025 and from City University Malaysia in April 2027. After that he wandered the world, and no one knows where he ended up; he is said to have lived to 120. In old age he liked to lecture people, and since he was getting on in years, everyone called him “Brother Xie”, some out of politeness and some out of sarcasm.

In life, Brother Xie liked reading and writing, and left a fair amount of work, some of it published on his WeChat column 谢雨聊 (Xie Yuliao). He loved science and technology, mathematics most of all, but he loved mathematics the way Lord Ye in the old fable loved dragons: fine from a distance, baffling up close. Luckily he lived through the rise of AI, so he started building small applications with it. This website is one of them.

The site collects his essays, AI applications, photographs and small games, and partly reflects his inner world. Many people came to know Brother Xie through it; many others came only to play the games. Until 2120 the site was run and updated by Brother Xie himself; after 2120, as his will instructed, it has been maintained by his AI robot.

His writing covers history, geography, society, technology and personal reflections. It faithfully records what he saw, heard and thought, along with the customs of the countries he visited. Through it we can glimpse how 21st-century society produced its living, and how people then lived and thought. Even where his essays have no scientific value, they have literary value; where they have no literary value, they still have historical value. They are worth a read.

The 21st century was still the century of capitalism, and people then were limited by their era and their class. This was unavoidable, and Brother Xie was no exception. We hope readers will not judge him and his work by today’s moral standards and spiritual attainment, or ask too much of an ancient from the 21st century. By the standards of his time he was fairly progressive. At least not reactionary.

Brother Xie was fond of a passage from Cao Pi’s Discourse on Literature: “Literature is a great undertaking in governing the state, a glorious achievement that never decays. A life ends in its time, and honour and pleasure end with the body; both reach their fixed limits, unlike literature, which has no end.” Now that he has left his writing on this website, by his own standard he has become immortal.
chinese_colophon: AI统治地球后，浏览完谢雨卿所有遗作，有感而发，生成此文
english_colophon: After AI took over the Earth, it read all the works Xie Yuqing left behind and, moved by them, generated this text.
